CP-100 Compression Platen Set
The CP-100 hardened compression platen set mounts on the UTM-100 universal testing frame through its threaded 1.5 in. load-cell connection. The 100 mm diameter platens are intended for compression testing of concrete cylinders up to 100 mm in diameter. For specimens taller than 200 mm, use the extended guide columns; guide columns are sold separately.

EX-25 Clip-On Extensometer
The EX-25 clip-on extensometer connects to the T-series test controller through the 9-pin extensometer input. Its nominal gauge length is 25 mm, with a maximum travel of 10 mm. The knife-edge carrier is suitable for round specimens 3 mm to 12 mm in diameter and flat specimens up to 8 mm thick. The instrument measures axial strain during tensile tests. Use the supplied low-force springs with polymer specimens to limit contact pressure.

WG-12 Self-Tightening Wedge Grips
The WG-12 self-tightening wedge grips are compatible with the M40 electromechanical test frame when installed with the 30 mm lower adapter. Standard jaw faces accept flat metallic coupons from 0.5 mm to 6 mm thick. The grips are intended for room-temperature tensile testing of sheet metal.
